description: The ECDH-ES examples of the COSE working group (https://github.com/cose-wg/Examples, directories ecdh-direct-examples, ecdh-wrap-examples and X25519-tests; released under the Unlicense), without the static-static variants. Distilled to what tests/ecdh.test.ts reads: the recipient key, the ephemeral private key and IV taken from each example's rng_stream (for P-521 the low 521 bits of the 66 bytes drawn, which is what the generator used), every intermediate value the examples publish, and the final message.
